pr_title: EL-1242 Instrumentation for enforce two factor page load

comments.body:
Question. 
Looks like you aren't using the response for a meaningful action other than error logging. 
Maybe ok to fire and forget?

`fetch` returns a Promise so this try-catch block won't actually do anything - as in the fetch can throw an error, but the error will propagate all the way up as an uncaught promise error. 
You can: 
- `await` the `fetch()` call inside the try-catch block
- Chain `.catch()` to the `fetch()` call. 
- Get rid of the whole try-catch block all-together.
